name: branding-wellness-capsule-bottle-and-app-icon-tiles
title: Wellness Capsule, Bottle and App Icon Tiles
whatItIs: A three-tile board: a hand holding a green capsule on black, a clear bottle printed with a grey petal-person logo, and a row of home-screen icons including the brand's gradient icon.
whatItMeans: Contrasting a dramatic photograph with clean product shots communicates a health brand that spans physical and digital.
techniques: Dark hero photo tile beside two clean white tiles
Overlapping translucent petals in the logo forming a figure
Logo shown on physical packaging and as an app icon
System-native icons alongside to test fit
Big rounded corners uniform across tiles
bestFor: Identity presentations spanning product and app

vocabulary.definition: Translucent shapes overlapping to create blended tones.
The largest tile in a board holding the boldest image.
Showing one logo on both physical and digital surfaces.
